best_idea: A fixed slot grid where each item has its own stack size, a stack fills the requested slot first, then partial stacks, then empty slots, and what does not fit is returned; the vendor buyback drops only its oldest entry when a sale really does not fit.
decision_why: Keep the slot grid with per-item stacks, the returned leftover, the per-item stash policy and the buyback list, but fix the room test that reports exact fits as full, and keep shared stashes out because they break the one-character, one-ledger ruling.
acceptance: Sell 10 units of one item to a vendor whose two buyback stacks hold 5 each: the sale fits, no entry is evicted, and a server test asserts the buyback list is unchanged and all 10 units are recorded; a 1-unit sale to a full buyback drops only the oldest entry.
